tooltips.eventTime: Time attributed to the offline conversion and sent to Google Ads.
tooltips.transactionId: Stable identifier used to deduplicate repeated uploads of the same conversion.
tooltips.validateOnly: Google Ads validates the request without applying the conversion when enabled.
tooltips.attributionType: Click or enhanced-conversion identifier type selected for this upload.
tooltips.identifierFingerprint: Non-reversible fingerprint used to diagnose attribution and deduplication without displaying the underlying identifier.
tooltips.attemptCount: Number of upload attempts made for this record.
tooltips.nextAttemptAt: Time when a retryable upload becomes eligible for another attempt.
tooltips.requestId: Request identifier returned by Google Ads for support and diagnostics.
tooltips.fieldWarnings: Non-fatal field-level warnings returned while preparing or validating the upload.
tooltips.errorCode: Google Data Manager or local processing error code from the latest attempt.
tooltips.errorMessage: Diagnostic message from the latest failed or skipped attempt.
